jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent Work Model:
Hybrid Reference code:
133696 Primary Location:
Toronto, ON All Available Locations:
Toronto, ON

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

What will your typical day look like?

We’re looking for an Engineering Leader to lead Frontier Engineering, Platform Engineering, and the UI/UX function.

This role is responsible for managing engineering execution, platform enablement, design quality, team performance, and delivery outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technology leader who can guide architecture, delivery, engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, AI-assisted development, and user-centered solution design.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Frontier Engineering, Platform Engineering, and UI/UX capabilities
Manage, coach, and develop direct reports both onshore and offshore
Set team priorities, delivery plans, standards, and execution expectations
Partner with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and delivery

teams

Oversee prototypes, proof-of-concepts, accelerators, and production-ready

foundations

Drive reusable services, frameworks, libraries, templates, and platform capabilities
Ensure platform solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, reusable, and maintainable
Provide leadership for UI/UX strategy, design quality, design systems, and interface
Guide technical design across applications, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, and

shared services

Promote CI/CD, DevOps, observability, automated testing, secure development,

and reliability practices

Embed AI-assisted development, automation, and agentic delivery practices into

engineering workflows

Manage team capacity, dependencies, risks, escalations, and delivery

commitments

Improve engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, standards, and

documentation

Build a high-performing culture focused on quality, accountability, collaboration,

and outcomes

About The Team

Frontier Engineering and Platform Engineering accelerate solution delivery through

modern engineering, generative AI, reusable platforms, automation, and delivery standards.

Frontier Engineering focuses on rapidly turning architecture and business requirements

into prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and production ready foundations.

Platform Engineering builds shared services, frameworks, tools, guardrails, and platform

capabilities that help delivery teams build securely, consistently, and at scale.

The UI/UX function ensures solutions are intuitive, accessible, consistent, and aligned to user and business needs.

Required Experience

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

10+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, solution

delivery, or technology leadership

5+ years of experience leading engineering or cross-functional delivery teams
Experience managing direct reports and developing technical talent
Experience coordinating distributed and offshore development teams
Strong full-stack development background across frontend, backend, APIs, and

data layers

Strong experience with .NET, NodeJS, Typescript, SQL, NoSQL, APIs, and cloudnative solutions
Experience with Azure and enterprise cloud platforms
Experience delivering production-grade applications, platforms, and shared services
Strong understanding of system design, microservices, integration patterns, and

event-driven architectures

Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable patterns, frameworks, and

developer enablement capabilities

Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, automation, Github Enterprise, release management, and modern development workflows
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, logging, reliability, and production support practices
Understanding of secure software development and platform governance
Experience working with UI/UX leaders, designers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders
Experience using AI/GenAI tools to improve development productivity and delivery speed
Strong leadership, communication, prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $215,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship with Indigenous communities in our shared goal of reconciliation and environmental sustainability.

jobs.title: Director of Digital Marketing (Remote, Kitchener)
jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Digital Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.
